portInfo.description: Flinders Ports is South Australia’s leading private port operator, owning Port Adelaide and six regional ports. The company describes Outer Harbor’s shipping channel as a busy hub where hundreds of trade and cruise vessels move goods and tourists into and out of South Australia. Contact listed: 296 St Vincent Street, Port Adelaide SA 5015; +61 8 8447 0611. A dedicated passenger-terminal specification page was not captured (deep URL 404), so berth length/depth and door GPS remain null.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Outer Harbor is not walkable to CBD — budget transfer time.
